verdict.rationale: Sunbiz publishes a numbered, task-oriented start-a-business guide (e.g., 'Step 2: Identify Your Type of Business — Decide on a Corporate Structure', 'Step 4: Register Your Business Name (Optional)'). Its annual-report page explains in plain language what can be changed, how to pay, how to reprint vouchers and what happens after filing, going well beyond bare form numbers and statute text. Missing for 10: evidence of the actual depth of the step explanations (only headings are shown), coverage of every step in the sequence, and independent or hands-on confirmation that non-lawyers find the guidance easy to follow.
